readmeExcerpt:
Copy this prompt and send it to your coding agent

```text Install Poki on my iPhone from https://github.com/JosssphZhou/poki ```

Connect your iPhone over USB and unlock it first. A free Apple Account works.

English | 简体中文 | 繁體中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Español
poki.bot

If Poki is useful to you, click ★ Star to support the project.

## What Poki is Poki is an open-source iPhone agent that operates your entire iPhone for you. The Poki app runs directly on your iPhone, reads the screen, and taps, types, and scrolls inside real apps using your own model account. You choose how it asks for permission; payments, deletions, and Wallet actions always stop for your confirmation.

## Why Poki

- **Skip multi-app tapping for everyday errands.** Ask Poki in chat, hold the Action Button, or trigger Siri to look things up in the built-in browser, check tomorrow's weather, or create a note. On iPhone Duo, Poki works across two apps side by side in Split View. - **Run saved skills by tap or by voice.** Launch a saved skill from the home screen instead of repeating the same steps every day, or start a hands-free spoken chat with Talk to Poki while Dynamic Island tracks each step. - **Automate your real phone without keeping a computer on.** Once installed from a Mac or Windows PC, Poki runs standalone on your iPhone with no computer attached and pauses on the Lock Screen or in Dynamic Island whenever a step needs approval. ## How to use ### Install Poki on your iPhone 1. **Install once from a Mac or Windows PC.** Connect and unlock your iPhone over USB (a free Apple Account works), then tell your coding agent, such as Claude Code or Codex: ```text Install Poki on my iPhone from https://github.com/JosssphZhou/poki ``` Or download [Poki Setup](https://github.com/JosssphZhou/poki/releases/tag/desktop-v0.2.8) for macOS (`.dmg`) or Windows (`.exe`) and follow the window. 2. **Connect and add your model account.** Accept **Trust**, turn on Developer Mode and Automation Mode when iOS asks, set up an external connection routing `10.7.0.1` back to your iPhone (such as free LocalDevVPN), and sign in with ChatGPT Plus or Pro or paste an API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, OpenCode Go, or an OpenAI-compatible server). 3. **Run your first task.** Open Poki and send: ```text Create a new note in Notes titled "Poki Demo" with these three lines: Milk, Eggs, Coffee. Open the note when finished. Leave existing notes unchanged. ``` Open Notes afterward to confirm "Poki Demo" exists with those three lines.

releases.body:
Pre-alpha: Poki 0.4.7 (1926), built from 058dfe6 (tag app-0.4.7-prealpha.1926). An untested snapshot of main for the Pre-alpha channel in Poki Setup; it can break. Use the Beta or Stable channel for anything you rely on. This release is updated in place with every Pre-alpha build.

Install Poki-external with Poki Setup, or sign either IPA with your own tool (entitlements in Poki-signing.zip). See native/ios-app/README.md.

Relay: Poki Setup's Update Relay deploys this release's relay Worker. To update it yourself, download [poki-relay-worker.js](https://github.com/JosssphZhou/poki/releases/download/ios-prealpha-latest/poki-relay-worker.js) (SHA-256 in SHA256SUMS), open your poki-relay Worker in the Cloudflare dashboard, choose Edit code, replace everything with this file and deploy. For a new relay, use deploy/cf-relay/deploy.sh.

### Changes since app-0.4.7-prealpha.1925
- feat(ios): refine the Poki wardrobe with native iOS design and interactions (#586) (058dfe6)

releases.name: Poki v0.4.6 Beta 1
releases.body:
# Poki 0.4.6

## A better personal agent experience

- **More everyday assistant interaction:** The built-in system prompt was rewritten around an iPhone-first personal agent. Replies are shorter and more decisive, with no step-by-step narration. (#479)
- **Live voice that reads the screen and goes straight to apps:** Live voice can now perceive what is on screen and open apps by name (for example, say "open WeChat"). The first reply automatically matches Poki's current interface language and is more concise. (#498)
- **"Poki Anytime" voice, available anywhere:** Bind it to the iPhone Action Button, or call it up any time from Shortcuts or Siri. You can use Poki voice without leaving your current app, and Poki understands and acts within the current screen right away. (#477, #497)
- **New launch screen (preview) and outfits for Poki:** The new launch screen is a first version and will be refined further. Poki's character can now change outfits, so dress Poki up for the cold weather. (#520, #536, #543, #552)

If Poki is useful to you, click ★ Star to support the project.

What Poki is

Poki is an open-source iPhone agent that operates your entire iPhone for you. The Poki app runs directly on your iPhone, reads the screen, and taps, types, and scrolls inside real apps using your own model account. You choose how it asks for permission; payments, deletions, and Wallet actions always stop for your confirmation.

Why Poki

  • Skip multi-app tapping for everyday errands. Ask Poki in chat, hold the Action Button, or trigger Siri to look things up in the built-in browser, check tomorrow's weather, or create a note. On iPhone Duo, Poki works across two apps side by side in Split View.
  • Run saved skills by tap or by voice. Launch a saved skill from the home screen instead of repeating the same steps every day, or start a hands-free spoken chat with Talk to Poki while Dynamic Island tracks each step.
  • Automate your real phone without keeping a computer on. Once installed from a Mac or Windows PC, Poki runs standalone on your iPhone with no computer attached and pauses on the Lock Screen or in Dynamic Island whenever a step needs approval.

How to use

Install Poki on your iPhone

  1. Install once from a Mac or Windows PC. Connect and unlock your iPhone over USB (a free Apple Account works), then tell your coding agent, such as Claude Code or Codex:

    Install Poki on my iPhone from https://github.com/JosssphZhou/poki

    Or download Poki Setup for macOS (.dmg) or Windows (.exe) and follow the window.

  2. Connect and add your model account. Accept Trust, turn on Developer Mode and Automation Mode when iOS asks, set up an external connection routing 10.7.0.1 back to your iPhone (such as free LocalDevVPN), and sign in with ChatGPT Plus or Pro or paste an API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, OpenCode Go, or an OpenAI-compatible server).

  3. Run your first task. Open Poki and send:

    Create a new note in Notes titled "Poki Demo" with these three lines: Milk, Eggs, Coffee. Open the note when finished. Leave existing notes unchanged.

    Open Notes afterward to confirm "Poki Demo" exists with those three lines.

Requirements, updating, common questions, and guides
Requirement
iPhone iOS 18 or later (iPhone XS, XR, SE 2nd gen or newer; iPadOS 18+ on iPad). Tested on physical iPhones with iOS 27.
Computer Mac with macOS 14+ (Node.js 24+ for agent install) or Windows PC (x64) with Apple Devices or iTunes.
Cable and account USB data cable and an Apple Account. Poki Setup renews free 7-day signatures while open, or sign in inside Poki.
Connection External connection routing 10.7.0.1 back to the iPhone (LocalDevVPN, Karing, or Shadowrocket).
Model account ChatGPT Plus/Pro sign-in, an API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, OpenCode Go), or an OpenAI-compatible server.

aiSummary.oneLiner: Automated agent that operates local iPhones via the Model Context Protocol without jailbreaking.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Poki allows AI agents to interact with a physical iPhone as a standard user would, completely locally. It implements a local Model Context Protocol server that translates agent intents into precise iOS actions. The system requires no extra hardware or jailbreaking to function securely. This enables complex mobile automation workflows directly driven by conversational AI models.
keyFeatures: Native Interaction: Simulates real touch events and gestures on unjailbroken iOS devices.
MCP Integration: Exposes device capabilities to AI models via the Model Context Protocol.
Local Execution: Runs the server and agent entirely locally to ensure maximum privacy.
Zero Hardware: Operates without requiring custom USB controllers or specific hardware dongles.
Workflow Automation: Translates high-level language commands into concrete application actions.
